headlines.title: Valkyries championship parade live updates: Bay Area celebrates another title
headlines.description: The Bay Area unites Wednesday to celebrate the Golden State Valkyries winning their first-ever WNBA championship in the team’s second season. Valkyries players, coaches and team officials will celebrate with a parade down San Francisco’s Embarcadero. We have crews stationed throughout the route and following the action. Follow along our live updates from the action:
headlines.source: Brendan Weber, Kristofer Noceda, Sara Bueno and Evita Isleta
